summary: iter-132 (deferred batch) verified: (1) Kiosk Razorpay polling overlay code path present in KioskPaymentModal with correct testid + isPolling guard; (2) Tiffin stock GET returns engaged/total_with_engaged and UI tile shows 'X in-hand + Y engaged' sub with total; (3) /admin/branding renders 4 uploader cards (brand, header, splash, kiosk) each with slot-suffixed upload + reset test IDs and correct 400/403 backend guards. 11/11 pytest cases passing.
critical_code_review_comments: branding.py: DEFAULT_BRAND_URL/DEFAULT_HEADER_URL/DEFAULT_SPLASH_URL/DEFAULT_KIOSK_URL are all the same string '/brand-logo.jpg'. Fine for now, but if you ever want a distinct default per-slot (splash-specific art etc), remember they collapse to one asset today.
tiffin_stock.py:_load_state: `engaged` is computed by iterating a cursor and summing tiffin_count in Python. For scale, prefer a Mongo aggregation with $group/$sum — negligible at MVP volume though.

KioskPaymentModal.jsx: Overlay CSS uses `animate-in fade-in` (tailwindcss-animate). Verify the tailwind-animate plugin is enabled in tailwind.config.js so this class is not silently ignored — otherwise the fade transition is a no-op but the overlay still appears (functionality unaffected).

AdminTiffinStock.jsx: Stat sub uses backticks even when engaged is 0. That's fine (shows 'X in-hand + 0 engaged') but you could hide the '+ 0 engaged' clause when engaged===0 to reduce noise on fresh installs.
test_credentials: Seeded ephemeral admin session TEST_sess_iter132_9dbf75bc (user_id=TEST_iter132_admin) via mongo; cleaned up after test. Auth via session_token cookie.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted 3 restaurant_tiffin_pendency rows (2 pending, 1 collected) inside test_engaged_reflects_pending_pendency and removed in finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend auth for admin endpoints accepts either Authorization: Bearer <session_token> OR session_token cookie — both resolve via user_sessions collection. To render /admin/branding & /admin/tiffin-stock in Playwright, seed a user_sessions row with role='admin' user and set the session_token cookie for the preview domain. Branding admin routes tolerate slot in {brand,header,splash,kiosk}; anything else → 400.
